# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 25 Oct 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Home Prices — Q3 2026 URA Data

- **Private home prices rose 1.4% in Q3 2026 — fastest pace in nearly two years** - URA data released 23 October shows private home prices accelerated from 0.5% growth in Q2 to 1.4% QOQ in Q3, even as the new launch calendar was quieter. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-rise-1-4-in-q3-2026-amid-a-quieter-new-launch-calendar/)

- **Price growth was fastest since 2024, but overall sales fell to this year's lowest** - Overall private home sales dropped 16.3% to 5,146 units in Q3 2026, with Lentor Gardens Residences and higher land costs cited among the drivers of price movement. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/private-home-prices-rose-fastest-pace/)

## HDB Resale Market — Q3 2026

- **HDB resale transactions hit a two-year high even as prices slipped for a third straight quarter** - Resale volumes surged 19.5% to 7,645 flats in Q3 2026 — the highest quarterly level since 2024 — while prices edged down 0.1%, continuing a trend of market stabilisation. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-a-two-year-high-in-q3-2026-as-prices-continue-to-decline/)

- **Record 596 million-dollar HDB flats changed hands in Q3 2026** - Despite the overall price dip, the number of HDB resale flats transacted at $1 million or above reached a record high of 596 in the quarter. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-resale-prices-fell-last-quarter/)

## Upcoming Launches & Rental Market

- **7,970 BTO flats launching in November — Bayshore and Caldecott among most anticipated** - The November BTO exercise will offer 7,970 flats, with Bayshore's waterfront setting and Caldecott's proximity to mature Toa Payoh amenities drawing particular attention. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/bayshore-toa-payoh-new-bto-flats/)

- **Condo and HDB rental volumes declined for a second consecutive month in September 2026** - Both condo and HDB leasing volumes eased further in September, though rents remained above levels recorded a year ago. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-rental-market-september-2026/)
